flawless: I named your fate before you drew it. Nebuchadnezzar does not guess.
Your hand was a scroll, and I read every line of it.
Kings have trembled at less. You never even made me rise from my seat.
solid: You hid a card or two from my sight. A fine trick, but not a winning one.
The stars favoured me, though you clouded them a little.
close: My visions faltered and you nearly toppled me. That is a story worth the telling.
By the old empires, I named every card but the one that almost ended me.
